list.title: Import from a legacy system
list.lede: Move the co-owner register, opening balances and bank balances from your old program or Excel into getproperty, one building at a time

empty.title: No imports yet
empty.body: Start with the co-owner register and the opening balances; payment history and bank balances can follow. Every row is checked before anything is saved

list.filesRows: {files, plural, =0 {No files} one {# file} other {# files}} · {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}

export.title: Export everything
export.body: A ZIP of every juristic table, the unit and owner register, bills and payments — one CSV per table with a manifest

line.files: {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} · {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}}
line.missing: {count, plural, one {# required file} other {# required files}} missing
line.units: {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} passed
line.errors: {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} to fix
line.matched: Totals match · {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} in arrears
line.committed: {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} imported
line.ready: {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} ready
line.differences: {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} to explain
line.parallel: Compare a cycle with the legacy system

wizard.title: Import from a legacy system
wizard.dataset: Dataset #{number} · {files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}}

body.upload: Upload the co-owner register and the opening balances; every upload re-checks all files
body.validate: Fix the rows in your file and upload it again, or download only the wrong rows, fix them and send them back
body.reconcile: Receivables and bank balances must match the legacy system on the cut-off date, or the difference is explained with evidence
body.commit: Review what will be created, then confirm. Opening balances stay drafts until go-live
body.golive: Compare one billing cycle with the legacy system, explain differences per unit, then go live

reason.missing_sheets: Upload {count, plural, one {# more required file} other {# more required files}} to check the data
reason.row_errors: Fix {count, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} to continue
reason.reconcile_first: Enter the legacy total and reconcile first
reason.explain_difference: Explain the difference with evidence to continue
reason.golive_parallel: Compare a parallel cycle before going live
reason.golive_differences: Explain every unit's difference before going live

panel.reversible: Everything can be rolled back until go-live. Imported balances are not billed or sent to owners before the last step
panel.pending: Until go-live, {building} issues no bills in the new system; the legacy system keeps billing
panel.readOnly: You can view this import; only the office's owner and managers can run it

closed.live: Live since {date}. Opening balances were issued as invoices; this can no longer be rolled back
closed.rolled_back: Rolled back {date}. Everything it created was removed; a new import of this building can start
closed.cancelled: Cancelled {date}. Nothing was created; a new import of this building can start

register.name: Unit and co-owner register
register.body: One row per unit and owner: unit no., floor, area, ownership ratio, owner, share, payer on behalf — ID numbers as the last 4 digits only

opening_balance.name: Opening balances
opening_balance.body: What each unit owed per period on the cut-off date, principal and surcharge apart; leave out units that owe nothing

payment_history.name: Payment history
payment_history.body: Payments of up to the last 12 months, kept as history for owners only — no receipts are issued again

bank_balance.name: Bank balances
bank_balance.body: Operating and fund account balances on the cut-off date, reconciled with the bank statements

legacy_bills.name: Legacy bills
legacy_bills.body: What the legacy system billed per unit in the compared cycle

upload.title: Files from the legacy system
upload.lede: Use each file's template; every amount is as of the cut-off date {date}
upload.privacy: Only the last 4 digits of an ID are kept; a row with a full ID number is refused and never stored. The import's row data is deleted 90 days after go-live
upload.errors: {count, plural, one {# wrong row} other {# wrong rows}}
upload.dropHint: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV, up to 5 MB and 5,000 rows
upload.tooLarge: The file is over 5 MB; remove unused columns and try again

validate.passed: Every row is valid, ready to reconcile {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}{warnings, plural, =0 {} one { · # warning that does not block the import} other { · # warnings that do not block the import}}
validate.title: Rows to fix
validate.lede: Fix the data in your file as listed, then upload that file again; every file is re-checked
validate.noFilesBody: Upload the register and the opening balances in step 1
validate.sheetCleanBody: Show all rows to review what the system read
validate.sheetEmpty: This file has no data rows
validate.sheetEmptyBody: Check that you used the latest template and kept the header row
validate.fixInFile: Fix the data in the original file or in the wrong-rows file, then upload it to replace the old one.

reconcile.title: Totals must match before going live
reconcile.lede: Check receivables and bank balances against the legacy system on the cut-off date before anything is saved
reconcile.receivablesLede: Principal and surcharge from the opening balances file against the legacy system's own total
reconcile.bankLede: The file's balance against the last statement balance on the cut-off date
reconcile.noStatement: No statement of this account covers the cut-off date yet; import it on the bank reconciliation page, or explain with evidence
reconcile.notRun: Not reconciled yet — enter the legacy system's total of receivables below

problem.declared_missing: Enter the legacy system's total of receivables
problem.declared_invalid: Enter a non-negative amount with up to 2 decimals
problem.note: Give the reason for the difference
problem.note_short: The reason is too short — at least 10 characters
problem.attachment: Attach evidence, such as the statement or the legacy report

reconcileForm.declaredHint: Principal plus surcharge on the cut-off date, from the legacy aged-receivables report
reconcileForm.noteHint: Explain where the difference comes from, for the auditor — e.g. an uncleared cheque, transfer fees
reconcileForm.attachHint: PDF or image, up to 10 MB
reconcileForm.heading: Legacy system figures
reconcileForm.rerunHint: You can reconcile again until the import is confirmed

commit.title: Confirm the import of {building}
commit.body: The register of {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} and {invoices, plural, one {# opening balance} other {# opening balances}} are created as drafts — not sent to owners, and reversible until go-live
commit.done: Imported — next, compare a parallel cycle
commit.consentBody: The register names a payer on behalf of the owner for {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}; attach the owners' signed consents (one scan may hold them all)
commit.consentHint: PDF or image, up to 10 MB

commitStep.emptyTotalsBody: Pass the data check to see what will be created
commitStep.title: What will be created
commitStep.lede: Figures of the last check; the import re-checks against the building when you confirm
commitStep.partiesNote: A person with the same name and phone or e-mail as one already registered is reused, not duplicated
commitStep.incomplete: {count, plural, one {# unit’s} other {# units’}} shares add up to under 100%; the register shows them as incomplete
commitStep.billTosNote: The consent document is attached when you confirm
commitStep.openingNote: Created as drafts and issued as invoices at go-live
commitStep.historyNote: Kept as history only; no receipts, since the opening balances already net these payments
commitStep.bankNote: Booked as opening balances at go-live
commitStep.openingsLede: Largest first · {count, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}
commitStep.openingsMore: The first 50 units are shown; all of them appear in receivables after the import
commitStep.before1: The unit and owner register enters the system at once; opening balances are drafts, not sent and not booked
commitStep.before2: Until go-live, {building} cannot issue bills in the new system; the legacy system bills this cycle, so nothing is billed twice
commitStep.before3: Everything can be rolled back until go-live; after go-live it cannot

cancel.title: Cancel import #{number}
cancel.body: This import's files will not be used and nothing has been created in {building}; you can start a new import later

rollback.title: Roll back the import of {building}
rollback.body: Deletes everything this import created ({created}), including bill drafts computed during the parallel cycle; nothing else is touched

golive.title: Go live with {building}
golive.body: {invoices, plural, one {# opening balance is} other {# opening balances are}} issued as invoices, bank balances are booked as opening balances, the building bills in the new system, and the import can no longer be rolled back
golive.notify: Send the opening balances to owners by LINE and e-mail
golive.notifyOn: Owners are notified like a new bill, with the usual due date
golive.notifyOff: Invoices are issued without a notice; owners still see them in the app
golive.acknowledge: Acknowledge {count, plural, one {# unexplained difference} other {# unexplained differences}}
golive.acknowledgeHint: Your settings allow going live; your name and the time are recorded

parallel.noCycle: The project has no open billing cycle. Open one to compute the bills to compare; nothing is issued before go-live
parallel.cycleHint: The same cycle the legacy system billed
parallel.computeFirst: This cycle is not computed yet; compute it to compare
parallel.legacyFile: Legacy bills of the same cycle
parallel.legacyDrop: Drop the legacy bills file here
parallel.legacyHint: Unit no. and amount per unit, Excel or CSV up to 5 MB

explain.title: Explain the difference of {unit}
explain.body: The new system computed {computed}; the legacy system billed {legacy}
explain.label: Explanation
explain.hint: 5–1000 characters, e.g. the legacy system included parking in the common fee

start.title: Start an import
start.body: One import per building; every amount in the files is as of one cut-off date
start.buildingHint: The building must already be set up; floors, units and owners are created from the files
start.asOfHint: The date of the legacy figures, e.g. the last day of the month before moving; today or earlier
start.noteHint: e.g. which legacy program the files come from

error.open: This building has import #{number} in progress
error.future: The cut-off date cannot be in the future

job_open.title: This building has an import in progress
job_open.body: A building has one open import at a time. Finish, roll back or cancel it first

invalid_state.title: The import has moved on
invalid_state.body: Someone already did this step or the state changed; reload to see the latest

preview_stale.title: Data changed since the check
preview_stale.body: The building or the files changed after the last check; check again before continuing

reconciliation_unexplained.title: The difference is not explained
reconciliation_unexplained.body: Reconciliation found a difference; a reason and evidence are needed before confirming

bill_to_consent_required.title: Attach the payer consent
bill_to_consent_required.body: The register names payers on behalf of owners; attach the owners' signed consent in the confirmation

rollback_blocked.title: Cannot roll back
rollback_blocked.body: Other records now refer to what was imported — a payment, an issued document or a lease — so nothing was deleted. Undo those first, then try again
rollback_blocked.blockedBy: A record still refers to what was imported ({what}), so nothing was deleted. Undo or reverse it first, then try again

parallel_cycle_missing.title: No parallel cycle yet
parallel_cycle_missing.body: Your settings require comparing one billing cycle with the legacy system before going live

differences_unexplained.title: Differences are not all explained
differences_unexplained.body: Every unit whose bill differs from the legacy system needs an explanation before going live

go_live_pending.title: This building is not live yet
go_live_pending.body: The import is confirmed but not live, so no bills are issued — the legacy system still bills

file_invalid.title: The file cannot be read
file_invalid.body: Use the template from the system, save it as .xlsx or UTF-8 CSV and try again

invalid_rows.title: The legacy bills file has wrong rows
invalid_rows.body: Check the unit numbers and amounts in the file and upload it again

scan_pending.title: The file is still being scanned
scan_pending.body: Wait a moment and try again

infected.title: The file is unsafe
infected.body: A risk was found in the file, so it was refused. Export it from the legacy system again and retry

not_uploaded.title: The upload did not finish
not_uploaded.body: The transfer was interrupted; choose the file again

rows.caption: File rows with the problems found

differences.caption: Per-unit bills, new system against the legacy system

reconcile.title: Reconciliation 100%
reconcile.done: {explained, select, 1 {A difference was explained with evidence} other {Receivables and bank balances match the legacy system}}
reconcile.todo: A difference is not explained yet

parallel.title: One parallel cycle compared
parallel.done: {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} compared
parallel.todo: Not compared with the legacy bills yet
parallel.optional: Not required by your settings, but recommended before going live

differences.title: Per-unit differences zero or explained
differences.done: {different, plural, =0 {Every unit matches} one {# difference, explained} other {# differences, all explained}}
differences.todo: {unexplained, plural, =0 {Waiting for the parallel cycle} one {# unit not explained yet} other {# units not explained yet}}
differences.optional: Nothing compared, so no differences to review
differences.acknowledge: {unexplained, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}} not explained; your settings allow acknowledging them when going live

goliveStep.liveBody: Opening balances were issued as invoices; {building} bills in the new system as usual, and collection steps count from the opening balances' due date
goliveStep.rolledBackBody: Everything this import created was deleted; start a new import of this building from the list
goliveStep.cancelledBody: Nothing was created; start a new import of this building from the list
goliveStep.parallelLede: Compute one billing cycle in the new system and compare it unit by unit with the legacy system's bills of the same cycle; the new system does not issue it
goliveStep.parallelOptional: Your settings do not require a parallel cycle, but comparing one catches a wrong rate or share before real bills go out
goliveStep.compareAgain: Compare again with another file or cycle
goliveStep.differencesLede: Every unit that does not match needs an explanation before going live
goliveStep.emptyBody: Show all units to review what the new system computed
goliveStep.checklistLede: Go-live opens when every item is done
goliveStep.after: At go-live the opening balances are issued as invoices in the OPB series, bank balances are booked, and the import can no longer be rolled back
